model.title: I&A Mission Reorientation Act of 2026
model.meta: Homeland Security Committee · Rep. August Pfluger (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would reorient the Department of Homeland Security's Office of Intelligence and Analysis to treat state, local, tribal, territorial, and private sector partners as equal priorities alongside other intelligence agencies. It would require the office to establish two-way information sharing with these partners, deploy intelligence resources to the field, maintain strong connections with fusion centers, and ensure that supporting DHS leadership does not compromise its obligations to local and private sector stakeholders.
